page_title: ATA 2-3 COM | Atalanta v Como 24/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's it for today, Paride Tremolada has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+9' 2 - 3 Goal! Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) puts the ball into the right side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Emil Audero.
90+7' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is going to take the penalty!
90+6' Paride Tremolada blows his whistle after Alberto Dossena (Como) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
90+4' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
90+1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) was quite harsh and Paride Tremolada didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' Cesc Fabregas prepares a substitution. Gabriel Strefezza is replaced by Yannik Engelhardt (Como).
89' The substitution has been made. Marco Sala (Como) has replaced Nico Paz.

86' Alessandro Gabrielloni (Como) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom left corner. Marco Carnesecchi has a clear sight of it makes a comfortable save.
86' Corner kicks – 6:2.
85' Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
83' A yellow-coloured card is received by Marten de Roon (Atalanta).
81' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Como, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
80' The referee blows his whistle as Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) was too aggressive in his challenge.
78' Atalanta have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
78' The resulting set piece from Atalanta is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
78' Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
77' A substitution has been made. Patrick Cutrone is replaced by Alessandro Gabrielloni (Como).
77' Cesc Fabregas decides to make a substitution. Maximo Perrone will be replaced by Edoardo Goldaniga (Como).
75' The manager makes a subsitution with Vanja Vlahovic (Atalanta) coming on for Ederson.
73' Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) gets on the end of a pass and takes a low shot from the edge of the box which is straight at Emil Audero, who makes a comfortable save.
72' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
70' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Atalanta comes to nothing.
69' Paride Tremolada blows his whistle for a foul after Gabriel Strefezza (Como) hacks down one of his opponents.
66' A cross into the box from Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is cleared.
62' Cesc Fabregas has decided to make a change. Luca Mazzitelli (Como) replaces Alieu Fadera.
60' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Ederson (Atalanta).
59' Substitution. Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) on for Charles De Ketelaere.

58' 1 - 3 Goal! Alieu Fadera (Como) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom right corner. Marco Carnesecchi had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:3.
55' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) replacing Davide Zappacosta.
55' Substitution. Mateo Retegui makes his way off the pitch and Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) comes on as his replacement.
54' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) scores an unlucky own goal! He deflects a shot into his own net.
53' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
52' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
51' Alieu Fadera (Como) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
51' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
50' Shots on target – 2:4.
48' Paride Tremolada has a clear sight and sees a foul from Alberto Dossena (Como).
47' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
46' 1 - 1 Gabriel Strefezza (Como) receives a great pass from his teammate and strikes a very powerful shot towards goal that goes inside of the right post!
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Gian Piero Gasperini gives a chance to Marco Brescianini and Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) is off.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45' Paride Tremolada has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
44' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
40' Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
39' Patrick Cutrone (Como) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Paride Tremolada signals.
36' Yellow card. Alberto Moreno (Como) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
35' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Gabriel Strefezza (Como), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
34' Patrick Cutrone (Como) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his shot goalwards, but the keeper produces a decent save!
34' The ratio of the ball possession is 54:46.
32' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) brings an opponent down and Paride Tremolada interrupts the game.
31' Atalanta enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
29' The corner is swung in but Como can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
28' Alberto Moreno (Como) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
27' Alberto Moreno (Como) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
25' Alieu Fadera (Como) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
24' The players claim that Patrick Cutrone (Como) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
21' What a miskick by Marc Oliver Kempf (Como). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.
21' It will be a corner kick for Como.

20' Patrick Cutrone (Como) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the roof of the net, but Marco Carnesecchi was alert and the score remains the same.
18' 1 - 0 Goal! Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) shows perfect technique and produces a first-time effort from just outside the box that goes into the bottom left corner. It's 1:0.
18' Atalanta will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
17' An attempted cross from Ederson (Atalanta) is cleared.
16' Como control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
14' Great teamplay by Como as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
11' What was Sergi Roberto (Como) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
8' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atalanta.

8' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) releases a powerful first-time effort from the edge of the box which goes in the direction of the right-hand post, but the keeper leaps like a salmon to deny him. Excellent goalkeeping! Atalanta earn a corner.
5' Ederson (Atalanta) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.

4' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Paride Tremolada blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
3' Atalanta can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
2' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
1' Como keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Como will take the kick-off.
Paride Tremolada is introduced as the referee for today's match.
